title: The Tyranny of Data Centers: Power and Water Usage

scenes.text: Data centers demand extraordinary resources, straining power and water supplies!
The massive cooling needs of data centers can lead to significant local resource depletion.
This resource consumption can affect local communities, leading to higher bills and shortages.
Technology needs to balance efficiency with sustainability to protect communities.
scenes.label: BALANCE IS KEY

scenes.text: Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.
